dedupe_keys.name: research data for techno economic planning of battery energy storage for renewable hosting capacity in active distribution networks

description: University of Zaragoza researchers publish inputs and final results for battery-storage planning in active medium-voltage grids. The free Zenodo ZIP uses CC BY-NC 4.0. It contains network tables, annual demand and weather inputs, technology assumptions, forty-five optimisation runs, Pareto fronts and robustness campaigns comparing lithium iron phosphate, vanadium redox flow and lead-acid batteries. The study combines NSGA-II and linear programming with degradation and AC-feasibility checks. These outputs can benchmark battery siting and renewable-hosting-capacity simulations. Related catalogue model-pandapower supports the Oberrhein and CIGRE modelling context; it does not explicitly include this study package. Coverage is stated benchmark cases and economic scenarios. Optimisation workspaces and development checkpoints are excluded, so figure scripts alone cannot recreate the complete search. No archive was downloaded, objective values checked or planning claim independently reproduced.
